gen-almendra-display-gf-momo-trust-displ: Almendra Display sets an ornate, literary tone, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height pronounced. Momo Trust Display, with drifting letters and a generous x-height, supplies the quiet clarity that makes the ornate heading feel intentional.
gen-almendra-display-gf-rambla: Lowercase that nearly matches the capitals keeps the text crisp, while Almendra Display adds ornate, literary curves that never pinch shut. Rambla holds the paragraph steady underneath, so the heading's flourish has something plain to push against.
gen-almendra-display-gf-viga: Viga reads with a uniform, shadow-free stroke and capitals that barely tower over the lowercase, so every line looks clean. Almendra Display handles ornate flourish; Viga handles steady, no-fuss text.
gen-almendra-display-gf-voces: Ornate on top, tidy below: Almendra Display, then Voces. Voces, built on a tall lowercase with stems and hairlines nearly matched, would glide through paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-almendra-display-gf-winky-rough: Letters that never seem to pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary look, backed by a pronounced x-height. Winky Rough keeps pace, its body height nearly matching the capitals.
gen-audiowide-fs-amulya: Futuristic from the first glyph, Audiowide sets the scene. Its single-marker-tip lines do the showing off, while Amulya does the quiet work, keeping gaps in its curves generous.
gen-audiowide-fs-plein: Audiowide sets glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, every curve drawn without any thinning. Plein leads each round letter in through a clear channel, a moderate-height lowercase that gives the loud heading reliable footing.
gen-audiowide-fs-roundo: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide spaces its glyphs apart with wide grout lines and a high lowercase. Roundo then brings a moderate lowercase height and unclogged small counters, so the loud heading never crowds the text.
gen-audiowide-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles, with wide grout lines and no thinning anywhere in the curves. Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs its oversized lowercase into tight word texture, so reading flows briskly from line to line.
gen-audiowide-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs rounded, open-sided glyphs into a dense huddle that the eye slides through, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Audiowide does its best work big and brief.
